{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.16

|serverExec= server

|gr1= Curator

|descr= Sets coef for some action (coef have to be bigger than -1 000 000, anything lower is considered as disabled action).

|s1= curatorObj [[setCuratorCoef]] [action, coef]

|p1= curatorObj: [[Object]] - curator module

|p2= action: [[String]] - can be one of:
* "Place"
* "Edit"
* "Delete"
* "Destroy"
* "Group"
* "Synchronize"

|p3= coef: [[Number]] or [[Boolean]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>curatorModule setCuratorCoef ["Place", 1];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>curatorModule setCuratorCoef ["Delete", -1e10];</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arma 3: Curator]]
}}
